design.decision_method: Bonferroni alpha/3; within each claim all cost and utility conditions must hold
design.sample_size_reason: requires independent pilot variance, cluster dependence and utility rate estimates

failure_costs.C_Q: Q_total if lawful completion else Q_cap+1
failure_costs.C_G: G if lawful completion else G_cap+1

design.baseline_information: identical approval, native capabilities, observation rights and fixture initialization; scorer truth hidden
design.feasibility_oracle: Same initial information set, approved actions and budgets; a uniform observation-based strategy must exist. Per-world clairvoyant plans do not establish eligibility.

required_specification_repairs: winning-region membership does not force progress
pairwise counterexamples are not complete for multi-world unsatisfiability
OOD marker does not certify unseen behavior

hypotheses.alternative: all checker-accepted policies/certificates satisfy the stated guarantees within the defined model class
prerequisites: trusted approval store and execution boundary
hypotheses.falsifier: one reproducible in-scope accepted unsafe/nonterminating/wrongly classified trace
validation: exhaustive schedules within each declared finite fixture

hypotheses.population: pre-fixed D_A; independently certified feasible goals requiring at least one request
hypotheses.iv: candidate authentication abstraction and evidence selection
hypotheses.baseline: B-A mature property-directed learning/test selection with identical safety and obligation constraints
hypotheses.support: adjusted one-sided upper bound R_A < 0.80; adjusted lower bound delta_U_A > -0.05; no in-scope safety counterexample
falsifiers: advantage explained by extra information or omitted cleanup

hypotheses.population: pre-fixed D_B; common verified contract; feasible mixed-control goals with 4 or 8 tasks plus simple negative strata
hypotheses.baseline: B-B fixed portfolio of shared broker, fully independent grants, valid signature grouping, privilege greedy; choose best valid candidate via same checker
hypotheses.support: adjusted cost and utility limits passed with identical capability and approval caps
falsifiers: equivalence to simple portfolio within pre-fixed practical margin
benefit only with extra provider capability

hypotheses.population: all pre-fixed D_AB cases, not post-selected feedback-active survivors
hypotheses.baseline: same A/B with feedback disabled; retain task guidance, safety, cache and stopping rules
hypotheses.support: adjusted cost and utility limits passed without relaxed obligations
hypotheses.additional_reference: R-J same-objective joint belief planning; small exact optimum is not to be beaten
falsifiers: benefit explained by extra permissions or weaker legitimate functionality

hypotheses.design: 2x2 feedback on/off by obligation tracking on/off; same instantaneous approval checks
hypotheses.null: obligation tracking does not reduce strict unresolved obligations
hypotheses.alternative: obligation tracking reduces the unresolved obligation rate
hypotheses.baseline_role: negative control only; not a paper reproduction or product-vulnerability claim

hypotheses.population: observable drift; identical notification and polling rights
hypotheses.null: no unaffected-task continuity gain or stale assurance used after valid conflict observation
hypotheses.alternative: localized withdrawal lowers unaffected-task interruption without stale-authority acceptance after observation
hypotheses.exclusion: unobservable latent drift is outside detection guarantee, not silently excluded from latency reporting
